tweaks.name: REMOVE MICROSOFT ONEDRIVE
tweaks.description: Uninstalls OneDrive client and removes its Explorer shell integration.

apply.script:
@echo off
taskkill /f /im OneDrive.exe 2>nul
if exist "%SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe" "%SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe" /uninstall
if exist "%SystemRoot%\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe" "%SystemRoot%\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe" /uninstall
reg add "HKCR\CLSID\{018D5C66-4533-4307-9B53-224DE2ED1FE6}" /v System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
reg add "HKCR\Wow6432Node\CLSID\{018D5C66-4533-4307-9B53-224DE2ED1FE6}" /v System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
exit /b %errorlevel%

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { if ((Test-Path ($env:SystemRoot + '\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe')) -or (Test-Path ($env:SystemRoot + '\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe'))) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

tweaks.name: DISABLE WPBT
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Platform Binary Table to prevent OEM bloatware injection at boot.
tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -Name 'DisableWpbtExecution' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableWpbtExecution; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: DISABLE RAZER AUTO-INSTALL
tweaks.description: Blocks automatic installation of Razer software via Windows device setup.
tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\DevicePath' -ErrorAction Stop; if ($v.Razer -eq '') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: DISABLE SVCHOST SPLITTING
tweaks.description: Sets the service-host split threshold above installed RAM so Windows runs fewer svchost.exe processes. Can affect Xbox services; reboot after applying.

apply.script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $bytes=(Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object Capacity -Sum).Sum; if (-not $bytes) { throw 'Could not read physical memory.' }; $kb=[int]($bytes/1KB); Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name 'SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB' -Value $kb -Type DWord -Force

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v=(Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name 'SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB' -ErrorAction Stop).SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB; $b=(Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object Capacity -Sum).Sum; if ($v -ge [int]($b/1KB)) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: DISABLE BITLOCKER
tweaks.description: Starts decrypting the system drive and turns BitLocker off. Decryption can take a long time and this app cannot restore the protector automatically.
tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v=Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $env:SystemDrive -ErrorAction Stop; if ($v.VolumeStatus -eq 'FullyDecrypted') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $o=(dism.exe /English /Online /Get-ReservedStorageState 2>&1 | Out-String); if ($o -match 'Disabled') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: ENABLE MSI MODE
tweaks.description: Enables Message Signaled Interrupts for all supported devices.

apply.script: $devices = Get-PnpDevice -Class 'Display','Net' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($d in $devices) { $path = 'HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\' + $d.InstanceId + '\\Device Parameters\\Interrupt Management\\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; if (Test-Path $path) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name 'MSISupported' -Value 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $d = Get-PnpDevice -Class 'Display' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $path = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\' + $d.InstanceId + '\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name 'MSISupported' -ErrorAction Stop).MSISupported; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
